name: lens
title: Lens
description: A round magnifying lens that follows the pointer over any content. Mouse and trackpad only: touch screens and reduced motion get the plain content. The magnified copy is hidden from assistive tech.

props.name: children
props.description: Content to magnify. Give it an opaque background so the lens reads cleanly.

props.name: zoomFactor
props.description: How much the lens magnifies. Values below 1 count as 1.

props.name: lensSize
props.description: Diameter of the lens in pixels.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for the lens to fade in and out.
